## Landing Pass Checklist

Complete every item before requesting Shane's review.
An unchecked box means this PR is not ready.

---

### Clean-Artifact Law
- [ ] No notes-to-self in any file
- [ ] No TODOs, reminders, or deferred tasks
- [ ] No process chatter or meta-commentary
- [ ] No hedges, unresolved questions, or placeholder text
- [ ] Every file states what it is — no more, no less

### Format Conformance
- [ ] Function folder follows FUNCTION_FOLDER_TEMPLATE.md exactly
- [ ] All four required documents present: RUNBOOK, PLAYBOOK, REFERENCE, CHANGELOG
- [ ] File naming matches the template specification
- [ ] No extra files added outside the defined structure

### Gauntlet
- [ ] This contribution has been through the Gauntlet
- [ ] Gauntlet result is documented (pass — no conditional passes)

### Gate
- [ ] This PR targets the correct branch (not direct to main from local)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or API keys in any file
- [ ] No content deleted — only additions or archival

### Contributor Statement

I confirm this contribution is a clean artifact, Gauntlet-passed,
and ready for Shane's gate.
